meta.title: Seller register
meta.rule: Contact details, return terms and payment options are only recorded where they appear on the seller's own site. A blank means 'not verified', never 'probably fine'.

sellers.name: Blue Nile
sellers.type: Online retailer (also owns / fulfils James Allen; both are Signet-owned)
sellers.contact_evidence: Product page footer: "Call +1-800-242-2728", "Send an Email service@bluenile.com", WhatsApp +1 877 374 9142, plus a Contact Us page link.
sellers.returns_summary: Free returns stated on product pages ("We offer free returns"). Full policy page not re-read for this pass.
sellers.returns_evidence: Product page "Your Order Includes" block: "Free Returns — Our commitment to you does not end at delivery. We offer free returns".
sellers.payment_note: Credit card accepted; site also advertises installment financing via Blue Nile Credit Card.
sellers.reputation_note: Reputation research not completed — see Flagged for Review. Only the company's own disclosures are recorded here.

sellers.name: James Allen
sellers.type: Online retailer (Signet group; shares catalogue infrastructure with Blue Nile)

sellers.name: Ross-Simons
sellers.reputation_note: Publishes an explicit "Gold Weight" in grams on product pages — one of the few sellers in this dataset that does. Third-party complaints about hollow gold exist but were not verified against an official source, so they are only noted on the Flagged page.

sellers.name: Mejuri
sellers.type: Online retailer with stores (Toronto / New York)
sellers.returns_summary: Free 30-day returns & exchanges from delivery; exclusions apply; engraved items not eligible for return; "Before We Melt" products are final sale.
sellers.returns_evidence: Product page: "We offer free 30-day returns & exchanges starting from the day the shipment is delivered or picked up in-store. Some exclusions apply" and "Note: Engraving is optional (complimentary) and not eligible for returns."
sellers.payment_note: Credit card; Klarna / installment options advertised.

sellers.name: Catbird
sellers.reputation_note: States on its own product pages: "Solid gold always, never plated". Not independently verified in this pass.

sellers.name: Costco
sellers.type: Warehouse club (membership required to buy online)
sellers.reputation_note: Included only because one Costco wedding-band URL surfaced during research and was found to be dead. No Costco listing is presented as buyable.
